en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival returns to Victoria Park next weekend
en.dek: The ninth edition runs free from 4 to 6 September at Soccer Pitch 1, after the main Hungry Ghost Festival day on Thursday.
body: The Federation of Hong Kong Chiu Chow Community Organizations will hold the ninth Yu Lan Cultural Festival at Soccer Pitch 1, Victoria Park, from 4 to 6 September, the Hong Kong Tourism Board and the organisers said. Hours are 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. and admission is free.

This year’s theme is Making Merit Visible. The programme includes a grabbing-the-orphans contest, a stacking of offering trays contest, a history exhibition, workshops on Chaozhou iron-rod puppetry and kung fu tea, and the immersive theatre piece Cross Beyond. Organisers said they expect about 40,000 visits, similar to last year. A 2.5-metre oiled-paper lantern will stand on the site.

Chiu Chow Yu Lan festivals, listed as national intangible cultural heritage, take place across more than 60 neighbourhoods through the seventh lunar month. The main festival day fell on 27 August. A visitor-only English guided tour of local Yu Lan gatherings is listed for 29 August, meeting at the Kowloon Visitor Centre at the Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry concourse; registration is free and limited to incoming visitors.

zh.headline: 第九屆盏蘭文化節下周末維園舉行 免費入場
zh.dek: 香港潮屬社團總會主辦活動於9月4日至6日在維園1號球場舉行，正日剛過，設搶孤及盆供比賽。
body: 香港潮屬社團總會將於9月4日至6日在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園1號球場舉辦第九屆盏蘭文化節，香港旅遊發展局及主辦單位公布活動詳情。開放時間為上午10時至晚上9時，免費入場。
今屆主題為「功德顯影」，節目包括搶孤競賽、盆供堆疊賽、盏蘭文化歷史展、潮州鐵枝木偶及工夫茶工作坊，以及實境互動劇場《渡海·渡人》。主辦方預計入場約4萬人次，與去年相若。場內將竪立高約2.5米的油紙燈籠。
潮人盏蘭勝會屬國家級非物質文化遺產，農曆7月在全港超過60個地點舉行，正日為8月27日。旅發局亦列出8月29日英語旅客專屬導賞團，於尖沙咀天星碼頭九龍旅客諮詢中心集合，免費報名，只限訪港旅客參加。
